name: בֹּהַן
summary: Joshua’s descriptions of the territories of Judah and Benjamin both locate their border by the stone of Bohan son of Reuben.

evidence.note: Judah’s boundary goes up to the stone of Bohan son of Reuben.
Benjamin’s boundary descends to the same landmark.

note: The name resembles בֹּהֶן ‘thumb’. Joshua identifies the man through the named stone and gives no explanation of his name.
